items.title: Judicial campaign-finance disclosure — TEC filings watch

items.summary: Monitoring published rules, reports, and legislative concepts touching guardianship oversight and probate jurisdiction. Confirmed official materials only.

items.summary: Watching public Chapter 87 removal filings and dispositions as they become available through official court channels. Entries will cite the specific cause number when confirmed.
